title: Self-Reflection Makes Large Language Models Safer, Less Biased, and Ideologically Neutral

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a dataset of LLM-generated responses about generic professions, categorizing them as biased if they needlessly use gendered pronouns and unbiased if they use gender-neutral pronouns, and evaluating the models' ability to identify and correct these biases through self-reflection.

Generating LLM responses on politically sensitive topics (e.g., healthcare, climate change), categorizing them as partisan-aligned (Democratic/Republican) or moderate, and evaluating the models' accuracy in detecting politically skewed versus moderate responses through self-reflection.
